reconstruction_summary: Re-ran agent's V4 (final) model: per-segment steering-bias (closed-form LS on each canonical segment) + per-platform gain k and understeer Kus from out/ladder_results.json + per-platform integer-sample yaw lag from the same JSON; prediction = v*k*tan(delta_road-b)/(L+Kus*v^2) shifted by k_lag samples.
notes: Agent's V1 per-segment bias was re-fit on each canonical segment (their original closed-form LS formula reused verbatim) — V1 is by construction per-segment so this matches what the agent shipped. Per-platform gains/Kus/lag were taken from the agent's out/ladder_results.json. Lag shift applied per segment (edge-sample carry) rather than across the platform-concatenated array; for 1-2 sample lags this is a negligible difference. bad/unreadable segments skipped: 0.
